transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um… I’m a little embarrassed to say it, honestly. I’ve been having times where I eat too much, and then I… I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up so I don’t gain weight. I know that probably sounds bad. I’ve been trying to handle it, but it’s gotten to the point where I’m scared I can’t stop.
How often do you have these episodes of eating too much?

Um… I guess more than I’d like to admit. For at least the last three months, I don’t think there’s really been a week where it didn’t happen at least once. It’s usually late at night, and then I end up making myself throw up afterward.

Some weeks it’s several times… especially if I’m home more because of my back. I’m sorry, I know that sounds like a lot.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yeah… I am. I try not to make it sound dramatic, but even if the scale is up, like, one pound, I get this panicky feeling. It’s like all the time I’ve spent laid up with my back means I’m getting soft or losing control, and before I can even think straight I’m already trying to figure out how to undo it. I know that probably sounds… not normal.
Do you exercise to try to burn off calories after you eat?

Um… not really, I don’t think so. I mean, I might tell myself I should move more or do something after, but with my back and everything, I’m not really doing workouts to burn it off. It’s more… I don’t know, I guess I mostly panic about it in other ways. Is that what you mean?
Have you ever eaten a large amount of food in a short period of time without making yourself throw up afterward?

Yeah… I mean, sometimes. I don’t want to make it sound like I’m just constantly doing that, but there are nights after everyone’s gone quiet where I’ll end up in the kitchen and just… keep eating. Like leftovers, cereal, chips, ice cream, whatever’s there.

It’s not really like a normal meal at that point. I’ll go past full, and then I look around and it feels like half the pantry’s been picked over. Sometimes I don’t throw up after, but I still feel really ashamed about it.
Do you ever engage in excessive physical activity to try to burn off calories or prevent weight gain?

I don’t think so… not excessive, anyway. I mean, with my back, I’m not really going out and doing some big workout or anything like that. Sometimes I get the thought like I should be doing more so I don’t gain, but I wouldn’t say I’m exercising a lot to make up for eating. Is that… is that what you’re asking?
Do you ever use laxatives or diuretics to try to lose weight or prevent weight gain?

Um… no, not really. I mean, I know what you mean, like taking something to… flush things out or whatever, but I don’t think that’s something I do to lose weight. I haven’t really used stuff like that that way. Is that okay to say?
How often do you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time without making yourself throw up afterward?

It’s… hard to say exactly. I don’t keep count like I probably should. It’s mostly at night, after everyone’s quiet, I’ll end up standing in the kitchen and eating whatever’s there—leftovers, cereal, chips, ice cream—and it kind of turns into more than a meal. Like, way more.

I don’t always make myself throw up after those times. Sometimes I just… stop when I realize how much is gone, like half the pantry looks picked over, and then I feel awful about it. I’m sorry, I know that’s not a very exact answer.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?

Um… yeah. I do sometimes. I don’t like saying that, but… it’s been happening more than I’d want to admit.

For the last few months, I’d say there’s barely been a week where I didn’t have one of those late-night eating things and then go make myself throw up afterward. Some weeks it’s more than once… especially if I’m stuck at home more because of my back. I know that probably sounds bad.
How often do you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time without making yourself throw up afterward?

Yeah… I mean, like I said, it does happen. Not every single time turns into me throwing up after, if that’s what you mean.

It’s usually at night, after everybody’s settled down and it’s quiet. I’ll go into the kitchen and just kind of start with leftovers or cereal, then chips, ice cream… whatever’s there. And then it’s suddenly way past what I’d call a normal meal, like I look around and half the pantry looks picked over.

I’m sorry, I know I already kind of said that. I’m not trying to exaggerate it or anything… that’s just how it goes sometimes.
How many times a week do you typically make yourself throw up after eating?

Um… typically? I guess… at least once a week. I don’t think there’s really been a week in the last few months where it didn’t happen after one of those late-night eating episodes.

Some weeks it’s… several times, especially if I’m home more because of my back. I’m not proud of that. I know that’s probably not the answer you want to hear, but… yeah, that’s the honest answer.
